g.title: OX02A
g.text: Behavior board • DRAFT • OWNER REVIEW PENDING

g.title: presentation
g.text: constructed from the same selected instant

g.title: reading
g.text: sg2_null_weather is a static debug trigger

g.title: parity
g.text: ROUTE PARITY GATE BEFORE ANY CONSOLIDATION
Compare at the same exact selected instant:
affected scene state + visible readout + timeline selection
Use scoped installed captures and direct interaction checks

g.title: state_route->parity
g.text: only after a real caller / trigger is evidenced

g.title: state_decision
g.text: Keep while caller / trigger / appearance is unverified
Do not remove it because production search found no caller
Record any real caller and its state before deciding

g.title: test_caller
g.text: Test source only; test not run

g.title: reading_decision
g.text: Consolidate into composition only if parity passes

g.title: exit
g.text: For reading + state-only routes: caller, trigger, source,
reachability confidence, and keep / consolidate disposition
Preserve composition-first behavior and preview separation

g.title: scope
g.text: No route is removed on static inference alone
The board is a proposal, not runtime or visual evidence
